reasons: DIRECTOR_BRIEF_011 and its referenced immutable execution-contract artifacts establish that the serializer, training schedule, launcher binding, cumulative 28800-second budget cap, CPU-only dummy tests, and source-provenance parity are frozen.

The local source files match the frozen byte counts and SHA256 identities for TRAIN.jsonl, TARGET_DEV.jsonl, and FINAL_AUDIT_SEALED.jsonl, but the complete remote preflight correctly fails closed at MOUNTED_DATA_FILE_SET_MISMATCH because those three exact files are absent from the mounted input directory.

The forced-PTY RunPod gateway rejects SFTP/SCP, so the remaining condition is an infrastructure transport problem rather than authorization to initialize a model, construct an optimizer, or consume GPU training time.

FINAL_AUDIT_SEALED.jsonl remains a sealed evaluation artifact: transport and hash verification must not deserialize it or expose its contents to the model, optimizer, training dataset, or training control flow.
No model load, optimizer construction, or GPU training has occurred, and the failed read-only preflight does not satisfy the conditions for scientific training authorization.

required_changes.action: Implement an infrastructure-only, byte-preserving transport over the existing forced-PTY SSH command channel using an ASCII-safe chunked gzip/base64 envelope. The manifest must bind each approved filename to its frozen uncompressed byte count and SHA256, the transport-envelope SHA256, ordered chunk count, and per-chunk SHA256. Use bounded independently acknowledged chunks and support deterministic resume without retransmitting or accepting an unverified chunk. Do not use SFTP/SCP, Git, public upload, or any unapproved external storage route for these data files.
required_changes.acceptance: Every received chunk, the complete envelope, and the reconstructed uncompressed file are verified against the frozen manifest. Any missing, duplicate-conflicting, corrupted, or out-of-order chunk; decode/decompression failure; byte-count mismatch; or SHA256 mismatch must fail visibly and must not publish a destination file.

required_changes.action: Before transferring scientific artifacts, test the exact transport routine with small CPU-only dummy UTF-8 and binary canaries, including reconnect/resume and idempotent replay. Add negative tests for corrupt, missing, duplicate-conflicting, and out-of-order chunks and for an incorrect pre-existing destination.
required_changes.acceptance: The valid canaries reproduce byte-for-byte and all negative cases fail closed. The tests initialize no model or optimizer and consume zero GPU training seconds.

required_changes.action: Transfer only the three already frozen local files TRAIN.jsonl, TARGET_DEV.jsonl, and FINAL_AUDIT_SEALED.jsonl. Reconstruct each into a temporary file on the same remote filesystem as its destination, verify the exact frozen byte count and SHA256, flush it durably, and atomically rename it into place. Preserve an already-correct destination; refuse or quarantine an incorrect destination rather than silently overwriting it. Remove incomplete temporary material after failure.
required_changes.acceptance: The mounted directory contains exactly the allowed frozen file set, with TRAIN.jsonl SHA256 97463689b4c47d912e20aa46fafe4c47b0e4ad538523ba8127145203f02acba1 and 9333559 bytes, TARGET_DEV.jsonl SHA256 e68b6d389fb51fe7f87311e13bd2630af2ce32c2e09b6314005d89983f924a97 and 465946 bytes, and FINAL_AUDIT_SEALED.jsonl SHA256 b01aabae5b7103efafe754d01b4af36a7b3fe21015adde63dedeef6d06411ddd and 309234 bytes, together with the previously verified retention sentinel. No additional scientific file may be introduced.

required_changes.action: Treat FINAL_AUDIT_SEALED.jsonl as opaque bytes throughout transfer. After exact-hash placement, make it read-only and record a receipt proving transport and hash verification only. The launcher and training code must remain unable to open, deserialize, tokenize, sample, or otherwise consume it; the read-only preflight may only stat and hash it.
required_changes.acceptance: Evidence records model_accessed=false, optimizer_accessed=false, content_deserialized=false, and the exact frozen byte count and SHA256.

required_changes.action: After provisioning, rerun the complete frozen read-only preflight from its first gate, not only the previously failing check. Verify the exact mounted file set and hashes, source and launch identity, serializer/schedule/launcher bindings, output isolation, and 28800-second cumulative budget reservation/cap. Preserve the exact next failure if any and stop there.
required_changes.acceptance: A new immutable preflight record reports PASS for every frozen pre-model gate, or reports a precise fail-closed condition. Passing this preflight still does not authorize model loading, base-reference collection, optimizer construction, or GPU training.

required_changes.action: Freeze the transport implementation, tests, transfer receipts, and new preflight evidence; commit and push them to the existing non-main experiment/infrastructure branch without force-push or history rewrite; then freshly verify local HEAD equals origin branch SHA equals the RunPod checked-out/source SHA and submit the next structured Director brief through the Supervisor Director-to-Controller path.
required_changes.acceptance: The resubmission records exact artifact hashes, fresh three-way source parity, zero model/optimizer initialization, zero charged GPU training seconds, and the final preflight result.
